blockers.title: On a flexible-crew course (D1, C1, C2, C3), two phones that fill the last seat of the same crew offline still break Equipaggi and the export
blockers.evidence: placementConflicts.ts resolveCrews: with standardCrewSize null a displaced member moves to loser.slot + 1 with no upper bound; the crew's stored capacity is never considered. readCrewPlan then calls normalizeCrewCapacity(capacity=2, memberCount=3) (src/domain/crews.ts:252-257), which throws; resolveCoursePlacements produces the same state and createCourseArchive refuses it. The unit case 'a flexible crew keeps everyone' never checks against a capacity; every placementConvergence scenario uses D2. Scratch output: 'readCrewPlan: Error: Invalid persisted crew capacity', 'export: CourseArchiveError: Il file contiene dati del corso non validi.'
blockers.reproduction: placementConvergence harness on real node:sqlite with the course at level 1 (D1). Phone A at 09:00 saves crew-1 (capacity 2) = [student-1, student-2]; phone B at 10:00 saves crew-1 = [student-1, student-3]; sync([A, B]). readCrewPlan and exportCourseArchive throw on both phones; Equipaggi shows its read-error state.

blockers.title: 'Riprova l'invio' loses a refused PATCH without notice: it re-queues an empty diff, deletes the refusal record and reports 'Tutto inviato'
blockers.evidence: uploadRefusals.ts retryUploadRefusals runs UPDATE ... SET <stored columns> = <stored values> on a row that already holds them, then deletes the record; the tables do not set ignoreEmptyUpdates, so PowerSync queues a PATCH with diff {}. Browser run (fake backend, pixel-7-chrome): refused PATCH body [{"declaredAgeAtCourseStart":16,"updatedAt":"..."}]; after Riprova the only write is PATCH students [{}]; the alert disappears and the line says 'Tutto inviato'. The only retry test covers a refused PUT.
blockers.reproduction: Accept everything, create D2 with Ada and Eva, sign in, wait for 'Tutto inviato'; refuse PATCH on students (400, 23514); edit Eva's age 15 -> 16; Impostazioni lists 1 refusal; stop refusing and tap Riprova: one PATCH with body {}, the record gone, 'Tutto inviato', the server keeps 15.

blockers.title: 'Riprova l'invio' replays an old snapshot over newer local state: with natural-key ids it overwrites a later evaluation (updatedAt moves back), deletes a later placement, and brings back an orphan that blocks the export
blockers.evidence: uploadRefusals.ts replays PUT as INSERT OR REPLACE with the queued columns verbatim (timestamps included) and DELETE as DELETE ... WHERE id = ?, without checking the row's current updatedAt or its parent. Scratch tests on node:sqlite: (a) refused PUT of evaluation '-' at 09:00, owner saves '++' at 10:00, retry: '-', updatedAt 09:00; (b) refused DELETE of landAssignmentId('sat-pm','student-1'), owner puts student-1 on land again (same id), retry: landAssignments 1 -> 0; (c) refused PUT of crewMemberId('crew-gone',...), retry returns 0 kept and exportCourseArchive throws.
blockers.reproduction: Scratch vitest from the placementConvergence harness: recordUploadRefusals, then a later saveEvaluation or saveCrewPlan, then retryUploadRefusals and inspect rows or export.
blockers.specRef: 04 B4 success predicate; 03 §3 (updatedAt never moves back); AGENTS.md §11

importantFindings.title: A refused PATCH of a row no longer on the device stays listed forever, and Impostazioni never again says the online copy is complete
importantFindings.evidence: retryUploadRefusals keeps such records with no way to discard them; 'Copia online aggiornata, tranne N rifiutate' and the alert stay until the course is erased or replaced; the 'non si può reinviare' count is component state and resets on remount.
importantFindings.reproduction: Record a PATCH refusal for an absent rowId; retryUploadRefusals returns 1 and the record stays.
importantFindings.specRef: 04 B4 adversarial checklist ('a refusal blocking the queue forever')

importantFindings.title: One refusal with an unknown table or column makes every retry throw and roll back
importantFindings.evidence: checkedColumns throws inside the single writeTransaction; OnlineBackup.tsx retry() has try/finally without catch, so the error goes unhandled and nothing changes. Such a record would come from a build with a different schema.

qolFindings.title: Crew history counts a member that the Equipaggi screen dropped
qolFindings.evidence: readCrewHistory applies resolvePeople but not resolveCrews; on a fixed-size course the earliest surplus member readCrewPlan drops still counts in the history until the next save of that session.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading; same setup as 'drops the earliest surplus member', then readCrewHistory before the save.

qolFindings.title: Older app versions drop uploadRefusals
qolFindings.evidence: An app's schema drops local-only tables it does not declare (03 §3); a 0.4.x build opening a synced database still applies its schema at init. Same-origin downgrade is unlikely; document it.
